items.zh: 修复：大师联赛外租球员到期归队时，如果原编号已被新球员占用，“继续”会一直提示 action failed、日期无法推进；已经卡住的存档，更新后按一次“继续”即可恢复
items.en: Fix: in Master League, when a player returned from a loan and his number had been given to a new player, "Continue" kept failing with "action failed"; a stuck career recovers on the next "Continue" after updating

items.zh: 优化：这次更新只需下载几 MB 的更新包，资源不用重新下载
items.en: Improved: this update is only a few MB; resources are not downloaded again

items.zh: 优化：更新改为在线更新模式，避免每次更新 3GB 安装包的繁琐过程
items.en: Improved: updates now work online, so you no longer have to go through a 3 GB installer for every update

items.zh: 新增：保莱塔、努诺·戈麦斯、尤西比奥、波比·查尔顿、博阿滕
items.en: New: Pedro Pauleta, Nuno Gomes, Eusebio, Bobby Charlton and Jerome Boateng
Improved: card packs are now in step with the official server

items.zh: 修复：大师联赛推荐阵容助手的 bug，以及部分赛季无法正常结算的 bug
items.en: Fix: bugs in the Master League recommended-lineup helper, and some seasons that could not be settled properly

caption.en: New players: Pauleta, Eusebio, Nuno Gomes

caption.zh: 新增球员：波比·查尔顿、博阿滕
